videoDetails.title: After the General Assembly: Reflections on Trust, Unity, and the Work Ahead
videoDetails.shortDescription:
The 53rd PCA General Assembly brought record numbers of overtures, voting delays, and several significant decisions—but it also revealed something more encouraging. In this conversation, Derek Radney, Geoff Ziegler, and Eric Bonkovsky reflect on why the Assembly ultimately fostered confidence rather than anxiety, how face-to-face statesmanship prevailed over online controversy, what the Assembly's decisions say about the health of the PCA, and the important conversations that still lie ahead.
